skill_name: Describe the origin and development of the given historic era.
workflow: The Renaissance began in Italy in the late fourteenth century and spread to the rest of Europe in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. It was an exciting time of cultural, educational, political, and artistic upheaval and transformation. During this time, Europe underwent intellectual and artistic rebirths, rediscovering and revitalizing the classical world of ancient Greece and Rome.
